name: ToolUniverse
description: Curates a large collection of scientific tools and MCP servers for AI scientists, exposing biomedical and research APIs through one Python SDK.

skills.name: Tool Discovery
skills.description: Searches a curated catalogue of scientific tools and returns callable specifications.

skills.name: Biomedical APIs
skills.description: Calls curated biomedical and chemistry data sources through one consistent interface.

skills.name: Agent Integration
skills.description: Serves the catalogue over MCP so any agent harness can load scientific tools at runtime.
